Image pixels per logical pixel; 0 uses the window's device pixel ratio. Default: 0.

detaileddescription.para: At a device pixel ratio other than 1, Qt 6.3 and later cannot render every image size, so a side can be a pixel shorter or longer than the plot's size times the scale.

briefdescription.para: Encoder quality from 0 to 100 passed to QImageWriter; -1 uses the format's default. Default: -1.

detaileddescription.para: Lossy formats (JPEG, WebP) trade file size for artifacts. PNG stays lossless and only trades file size for encoding time. Other formats ignore it.

briefdescription.para: Resolution stored in saved files, in dots per inch; 0 stores 96 times the effective scale. Default: 0.

detaileddescription.para: The default makes documents place the image at its on-screen size.

briefdescription.para: Leaves out the plot's axesAreaColor and plotAreaColor backgrounds. Default: false.

detaileddescription.para: Grid, series, axes, and child items such as the legend are drawn as usual. Formats without an alpha channel, such as JPEG, composite the image over white. The plot shows no background for the frame it is captured in.

memberdef.name: saveInBackground

briefdescription.para: Exports a plot as a raster image: to a file, to the clipboard, or as a QImage.

detaileddescription.para: The capture contains the plot item and everything drawn inside its bounds, as on screen: series, axes, legend, overlays, and any child items. Children outside the bounds are clipped. The plot must be visible in a window that is shown, not minimized, and renders through a hardware scene graph backend.

Every request is asynchronous and ends with exactly one finished() signal, except one made while busy: it returns false with a warning and leaves finished() to the request in progress. A request for a plot another exporter is capturing fails. The capture is taken on the next frame, and fails when the window is hidden, minimized, or destroyed first; encoding and writing a file run on a worker thread.
